gate_headroom.clock: Gate offsets are elapsed seconds from each head's labeled workflow-start proxy, as supplied in the reviewed input.
gate_headroom.assumption: Scenarios subtract the stated seconds from observed gate offsets, clipping each at zero, while holding other gate clocks and dependency structure fixed; adjusted completion order may change. This is a conditional upper-bound sensitivity, not a treatment effect or actual auto-merge readiness; do not add worker or CPU times.

occupancy.scope: core workflows; completed positive-runner jobs; clipped to window; excludes other workflows/repos and unfinished jobs

newer_full_test.source_provenance_note: Exact mainline test invocation metadata and enclosing push job agree on e744e2cd0bb0faac1db9f005c418171ad17079f8; see timelines.

oom_first_command_trace.cause_model: First command pays for actual input admission, Codex exec-server and app-server cold initialization, thread/start response and first scripted Codex turn; MEMORY_PROBE shell work is about one second.
oom_first_command_trace.visibility_limit: Mixed host/test/guest event timestamps are not independently skew-calibrated; native and console events do not break app-server init, protocol response, scheduler and transport gaps into CPU vs waiting time. No cgroup cpu.stat or pressure samples retained for this pre-OOM interval.
oom_first_command_trace.next_observation: Use existing native/profiler spans for app-server initialize and thread/start, plus guest scheduling/pressure counters, on same full suite; preserve real cold-start and first-turn assertions.
